provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Grants an action or an amount and denies that it changes the outcome: だって after ta-stems that voice the た (読んだって, 急いだって), たって elsewhere (食べたって), often paired with いくら (いくら考えたって). Three siblings share the string: 'even' on a bare noun (子供だって), hearsay news (臨時休業だって), and a rising-tone checking question (校庭だって？). It belongs to everyday speech; ても and にしても are the written counterparts.

examples.ruby: 今[いま]から呼[よ]んだって、もう間[ま]に合[あ]わないだろう。
examples.english: Calling him now isn't going to get him here in time.

examples.ruby: 傘[かさ]を持[も]って行[い]ったって、この風[かぜ]じゃ意味[いみ]がないよ。
examples.english: Even if you take an umbrella, it's no use in wind like this.

examples.ruby: いくら考[かんが]えたって、いい案[あん]なんて浮[う]かばない。
examples.english: No matter how hard I think, no good ideas come to me.

patterns.usage_note: Sets up a supposition that has not come about and denies that it would change anything: 明日から始めるとしたって間に合わない. The sibling lane instead grants a claim already put forward as true and brushes it aside (いくら安いとしたって). Attaches to plain forms, including だ and た; としても is the same expression in neutral register.

examples.ruby: 明日[あした]から始[はじ]めるとしたって、準備[じゅんび]がまるで足[た]りない。
examples.english: Even if we start tomorrow, we're nowhere near ready.

examples.ruby: 薬[くすり]が効[き]いたとしたって、この熱[ねつ]では明日[あした]も休[やす]むしかない。
examples.english: Even if the medicine did work, with a fever like this I'll have to take tomorrow off too.

examples.ruby: 今度[こんど]の試合[しあい]に勝[か]つとしたって、優勝[ゆうしょう]にはまだ届[とど]かない。
examples.english: Even if we win the next match, we still won't reach the title.

patterns.usage_note: Supposes a case that has not come about and says it changes nothing: the clause before it is granted for the sake of argument (手伝うにしたって, 雨が降るにしたって) and the main clause holds regardless. Sibling lanes start from a case that is already real (部長にしたって), add a further party the same thing holds of (親にしたって), or sweep in every case after an interrogative (誰にしたって).

examples.ruby: 安[やす]く買[か]えるにしたって、これ以上[いじょう]物[もの]は増[ふ]やせない。
examples.english: Even supposing I could get it cheap, I've no room for another thing.

examples.ruby: 手伝[てつだ]うにしたって、これだけの量[りょう]は今日[きょう]中[じゅう]に終[お]わらない。
examples.english: Even if I pitch in, there's no finishing this much today.

examples.ruby: 明日[あした]雨[あめ]が降[ふ]るにしたって、準備[じゅんび]だけは進[すす]めておこう。
examples.english: Even if it does rain tomorrow, let's at least get the preparations done.

glosses: even if you … (it would change nothing)
patterns.usage_note: Supposes an action not yet taken and denies it would change anything: the ta-form here is not past, and the main clause says things stand as they are regardless (今から走ったところで間に合わない). The 確定 sibling looks back on a settled past and denies a different choice would have helped (あのとき謝ったところで). Casual speech clips ところ to とこ (騒いだとこで), and the main clause is a judgment rather than a command.

examples.ruby: そんなに水[みず]をやったところで、この鉢[はち]の花[はな]は元気[げんき]にならないよ。
examples.english: Watering it that much isn't going to perk up the flowers in this pot.

examples.ruby: ここで騒[さわ]いだとこで、決[き]まったことはひっくり返[かえ]らないよ。
examples.english: Kicking up a fuss here isn't going to overturn what's already been decided.

examples.ruby: 今[いま]さら言[い]い訳[わけ]を並[なら]べたところで、信用[しんよう]は戻[もど]らない。
examples.english: Piling up excuses at this point isn't going to win back anyone's trust.

patterns.usage_note: Concedes any degree or outcome and asserts that the main clause holds regardless: it attaches to the volitional form (時間がかかろうとも, 何を言われようとも, 険しかろうとも) and is typically reinforced by たとえ or どんなに. Dropping the も gives 〜うと, the same meaning carried more lightly. Both are written and declamatory; ても is the everyday equivalent.

examples.ruby: どんなに時間[じかん]がかかろうとも、最後[さいご]までやり抜[ぬ]く。
examples.english: However long it takes, I will see this through to the end.

examples.ruby: たとえ全[すべ]てを失[うしな]おうとも、この信念[しんねん]だけは曲[ま]げない。
examples.english: Even if I lose everything, this one conviction I will not bend.

examples.ruby: 周[まわ]りに何[なに]を言[い]われようとも、妹[いもうと]は毎朝[まいあさ]の練習[れんしゅう]をやめなかった。
examples.english: No matter what anyone said to her, my sister never once skipped her morning practice.

glosses: regardless of; no matter whether … or not
patterns.usage_note: Sets up a condition the speaker rules out in advance: volitional plus が, with the main clause holding whatever happens (誰が反対しようが, 雨が降ろうが槍が降ろうが). The other entry for this form is the sentence-final reproach, a rhetorical question thrown at the hearer (だから言っただろうが). It often pairs two opposed or parallel conditions (行こうが行くまいが), and the second clause typically states resolve or indifference: 勝手だ, 関係ない, 自由だ.

examples.ruby: 誰[だれ]が反対[はんたい]しようが、この企画[きかく]は必[かなら]ず通[とお]してみせる。
examples.english: I don't care who objects; I'm getting this project approved.

examples.ruby: 結果[けっか]がどう出[で]ようが、私[わたし]は自分[じぶん]の選択[せんたく]を悔[く]やまない。
examples.english: However it turns out, I won't regret the choice I made.

examples.ruby: 値段[ねだん]が上[あ]がろうが、この味噌[みそ]だけは他[ほか]に替[か]えられない。
examples.english: The price can climb all it likes; this is the one miso I won't trade for another.

patterns.usage_note: Concedes a supposition that has not come about (雨が降るにしろ, 引っ越すにしろ) and says the main point holds all the same; doubled as 〜にしろ〜にしろ it lists alternatives, and after an interrogative (誰にしろ, どこへ行くにしろ) it means whoever or wherever. Sibling entries concede something already established (断られたにしろ) or raise a noun as a case that is no exception (新人にしろ). Formal counterpart of にしても, with にせよ stiffer still.

examples.ruby: 賛成[さんせい]するにしろ反対[はんたい]するにしろ、理由[りゆう]は述[の]べてほしい。
examples.english: Whether you're for it or against it, I'd like to hear your reasons.

examples.ruby: 引[ひ]っ越[こ]すにしろ、この部屋[へや]の荷物[にもつ]は半分[はんぶん]に減[へ]らすしかない。
examples.english: Even if you do move, there's nothing for it but to cut what's in this room by half.

examples.ruby: 冗談[じょうだん]にしろ、あの言[い]い方[かた]は失礼[しつれい]すぎる。
examples.english: Even supposing it was a joke, putting it that way was flat-out rude.
